informal_statement: Normalized cap area tends to zero as the angle decreases to zero.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At MorgansArcFunction.lean:173-187, the source contract is `lemma area_tendsto_zero : Tendsto area (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)`. The unit-chord normalized area and arc length are constructed on 0 < theta < pi. The inverse is used geometrically only at positive area; its explicit totalization is not confused with an inverse outside that domain.
